QuestInfo.name: Lost in the Forest of Peace
QuestInfo.0: You're lost in the Forest of Peace... Talk to Arin.
QuestInfo.1: You're totally lost. Will you ever find the White Mage?\r\n#b(Go to the right and see if there is an exit anywhere.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You lost your way in the Forest of Peace but you were able to meet the White Mage. You went to the Aurora Great Temple with his guide.

default.0: Don't try to run. If you do, I'm gonna chase you to the ends of the world. I'll be resting right here.\r\n#b(Go to the rightmost end of the forest and find a way.)#k
